record.title: Ben's bibliography
record.name: BensBibliography
record.content:
This is just to have a central bibliography to make it easy for me to copy into articles.
Benbrook, J. "Intermediate Electromagnetic Theory", lecture notes, University of Houston, Fall 2002.
Ellis, R., Gulick, D. "Calculus" Harcourt Brace Jovanovich, Inc., Orlando, FL, 1991.
Friedman, B. "Principles and Techniques of Applied Mathematics" John Wiley \& Sons, Inc., New York, 1956.
Greven, A., Keller, G., Warncke, G. "Entropy" Princeton University Press, New Jersey, 2003.
Griffiths, D. "Introduction to Electrodynamics", Prentice-Hall, Inc., 1999.
Griffiths, D. "Introduction to Quantum Mechanics" Prentice Hall, New Jersey, 1995.
Guterman, M., Nitecki, Z. "Differential Equations" 3rd Edition. Saunders College Publishing, Fort Worth, 1992.
Halliday, D., Resnick, R., Walker, J.: "Fundamentals of Physics". 5th Edition, John Wiley \& Sons, New York, 1997.
Jackson, D. "Classical Electrodynamics", John Wiley and Sons, Inc., 1975.
Kittel, C., Kroemer, H. "Thermal Physics" Second Edition. W.H. Freeman and Company, New York, 1980.
Kondepudi, D., Prigogine, I. "Modern Thermodynamics From Heat Engines to Dissipative Structures" John Wiley \& Sons, Chichester, 1998.
Krane, K., "Modern Physics." Second Edition. New York, John Wiley \& Sons, 1996.
Marsden, J., Tromba, A. "Vector Calculus" Fourth Edition. W.H. Freeman Company, 1996.
Thornton, S., Rex, A., "Modern Physics For Scientists and Engineers." Second Edition. Fort Worth, Saunders College Publishing, 2000.
